# uptimeify_customer_api_token (Resource)

A customer-scoped API token (`wsm_...`, limited to one customer). A token created by Terraform with an API token runs with the role `readonly`, because its issuer is a token, not a person. The token value is returned once, on create, and kept in the state as a sensitive value; it cannot be read again, so an imported token has no `token`. Every change creates a new token. Import with the numeric id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeify_customer_api_token" "shop" {
  name            = "Shop integration"
  customer_id     = 12
  expires_in_days = 365
}

output "shop_token" {
  value     = uptimeify_customer_api_token.shop.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_id` (Number) The customer the token is limited to. Required: the API cannot revoke an organization-wide token created here.
- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `expires_in_days` (Number) Lifetime in days from creation. Unset = never expires. Only sent on create (not readable; see `expires_at`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_used_at` (String)
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token itself. Only known after create; empty after import.
- `token_hint` (String) Short recognition hint shown in the dashboard.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Numeric token id (the token value cannot be imported)
terraform import uptimeify_customer_api_token.shop 16
```
